body_html:
Bingo at Pinehurst Country Club for 4th of July of such a great tradition they have and the older people and the young kids all seem to enjoy it! not only that, but it is great getting out of the heat for a while after being outside all day for most of the people. In the end we even managed to somehow have everyone get a prize from winning a bingo at least once! JAMMIN’ DJs can host a huge variety of events, and Bingo is certainly one of them!

DJ Cameron
